unit: unique versioned paper and repository pair

selection.ordering: ascending SHA-256 of ordering_salt, paper_url_versioned, and code_url_versioned
selection.assignment: first 8 eligible units are development; next 40 are confirmatory

eligibility: one versioned repository URL per paper
versioned paper PDF responds to a bounded request
repository commit archive responds to a bounded request
license text at the recorded commit is classified as MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, or CC-BY
forbidden_inputs: All discrepancy descriptions, gold relevant files, gold paper sections, changed files, and changed snippets
kill_rule: KILL_DATASET when fewer than 48 eligible independent units are found among the first 96 hash-ordered units
execution_after_pass: Freeze the retrieval/evaluation contract before inspecting development retrieval outcomes; keep confirmatory gold sealed until the method is frozen
